rules.statement: When title is retransferred, subsequent transferee acquires title by operation of law.
rules.supporting_quote: On the principle exceptio rei vendita et traditae, when Podi Appuhamy retransferred his title to Charles Appu, Charles Appu's title devolved on Swarna Jayanthi by operation of law. As such Charles Appu had no interests to convey to his wife Charlotte and consequently Charlotte could not have conveyed any interests to the plaintiff. 2. The plaintiff had not established a title superior to that claimed by the defendant's wife
